title.narrative: Increase community resilience to food insecurity & enterprise development

description.narrative: CAFOD supports the Kambia District Development and Rehabilitation organisation-KADDRO to “increase community resilience to food insecurity and emergency preparedness”. In the last few months the project has worked towards enhancing sustainable livelihood among farmers through diverse methods that promotes increased production, diversification and adaptive farming practices. This project is further complemented with a recovery project that aims to develop sustainable and alternative livelihood opportunities for Ebola affected communities including; the provision of farming inputs, value addition on agricultural product, skills and knowledge building, sensitization, awareness raising and the promotion of food and nutrition security in 15 communities. CAFOD is seeking to scale up this project as it contributes to Sierra Leone presidential recovery priorities, which is a 24-month plan that includes Agriculture under the national Ebola response and recovery framework. The project will also weigh in on CAFOD sierra Leone Country Strategy Paper 2016- 2021 objectives
